newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes slightly up vs US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes slightly up vs US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed slightly up at 8.2947 against the U.S. dollar on Monday from Sunday's 8.2952 in Shanghai due to strong pro-yuan sentiment, dealers said.
The weighted average price on Sunday was 8.2949.
Dealers said that after Sunday's correction, the yuan found firm support at about the 8.2950 level.
The yuan opened unchanged at an intraday low of 8.2952 and rose steadily to move in a narrow range of 8.2945 and 8.2949 for most of the session, hitting a high of 8.2943 late in the session.
Trading was active with most done at 8.2948, dealers said.
"The yuan opened below the 8.2950 level, but buying was seen soon after which pushed it above that key level," said one dealer.
A second dealer said the upward potential would be limited in the short term due to a lack of market-moving news.
"I think the yuan will consolidate at about the 8.2950 level in the next few days," he said.
Dealers said they expected the yuan to move around the current level on Tuesday.
The yuan closed little changed at 6.5431 from 6.5400 against 100 Japanese yen and up at an intraday high of 1.0700 from 1.0715 against the Hong Kong dollar.
